subject: FerroUI PR496 internal-function PGO key mismatch
status: Original/latest484 key mismatch and fresh stage2 optimized IR recovery verified; speed impact is subject to paired benchmark results
conclusions: Source-identical notification functions moved from codegen module03 to02; their local profile keys no longer matched the reused original profile.
Preserved latest484 optimized Base bitcode lacks the previously present function-entry profile metadata and promoted root virtual-handler path.
All15 selected fresh-stage2 function CFG hashes and complete edge-counter vectors exactly match the original training profile; internal-function keys now identify stage2 module12.
Boxed i32 observer functions have zero counters in both training profiles. This existing training gap is separate from the missing internal-function keys.
Stage2 optimized Base consumes the cgu.12 keys: function-entry metadata, promoted FerroObject root-handler comparisons, and inlined handler-list emptiness checks are restored.
limitations: Observed code-generation changes do not establish their percentage contribution to runtime regression; paired timings remain necessary.
Reference pre-LTO function-entry counts are adjusted by inlining and optimization and differ from raw edge-counter maxima.
Stage2 recovery is verified in optimized Base bitcode before final consumer LTO; final linked machine code and runtime timings are separate evidence.

fresh_profile.recipe: Same original profile_winui.py training cases, distinct fresh raw directory, no QA lanes. Existing instrumentation target reused at the original -Cprofile-generate path. Final whole graph uses a new content-addressed profile path.
